Dubai’s glittering skyline is bestowed by some of the most iconic skyscrapers in the world. These buildings boast stunning architecture and spellbinding designs. Some common examples are the tallest building in the world, Burj Khalifa, Marina 101, Princess Tower, 23 Marina and many more.

Apart from their architecture, these buildings are also famous for the ultra-luxury amenities they come with. You will find some of the finest Dubai properties in these developments. The latest ones, in particular, are adorned with state-of-the-art facilities and conveniences that play a prominent role in defining an upscale lifestyle the city is well-known to offer.

With that said, let’s take a look at 5 latest skyscrapers in Dubai:

Latest Skyscrapers in Dubai

1. Address Residences Jumeirah Resort

Luxury meets beachfront lifestyle at Address Residence Jumeirah Resort. It is one of the most popular luxury residential skyscrapers in Dubai occupying a prime spot in the most popular neighbourhood – Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR).

The strategic location of this development allows residents to cherish the unobstructed views of the sea, right from their bedroom windows. Furthermore, they can also enjoy the panoramic sights of Bluewaters Island and Dubai Marina. It is a thoughtfully designed and masterfully planned project that features apartments in varying sizes and configurations. All the units feature international standard furnishings and finishing.

Standing tall at 75 floors, Address Residences is the first beachfront development by Address Hotels + Resorts in the emirate.

2. Al Habtoor City

Al Habtoor City is not just a skyscraper but a collection of skyscrapers. This multi-use development features three hotels along with the same number of high-rise residential towers; Noora, Amna and Meera.

Among these towers, two feature 73 storeys each, while the third one has 52 floors. In total, there are over 1400 apartments and 12 penthouses for buyers to choose from.

This development is located near the Dubai Water Canal and presents an opportunity to lead a luxurious lifestyle filled with modern amenities and facilities. Living spaces in these towers are designed in Art Deco style and symbolise refinement and heritage while featuring contemporary fittings and fixtures.

These towers have a splendid façade and sophisticated interiors that give them a striking appearance. You can find 1, 2, 3 and 4-bedroom contemporary apartments designed to perfection. These units come with private balconies and floor-to-ceiling windows so that you can enjoy the panoramic views of the surroundings.

3. Downtown Views

Featuring a true combination of luxury, comfort and style, Downtown Views is a premium residential development that encapsulates 424 apartments in varying layouts and configurations. It is a 55-storey tower that offers 360-degree views of the entire city due to its strategic location.

The development sits on a 9-storey podium that is an integral part of The Dubai Mall extension. It is located in Downtown Dubai and provides residents with convenient access to the rest of the city. As a resident of Downtown Views, amenities and facilities are within an arm’s reach. Furthermore, its proximity to Al Khail Road, Sheikh Zayed Road and other popular communities eliminates commutation hassles.  

Life is definitely quite convenient if you buy a property in Downtown Views, one of the most popular skyscrapers in Dubai.

4. DAMAC Paramount Hotel & Residences

The next spot in the list of the latest skyscrapers in Dubai is occupied by the magnificent popular DAMAC Paramount Hotel & Residences. As the name specifies, it is a hotel and resident building combined featuring luxury rooms and accommodations.

This ultra-luxury development stands tall with all its might and grace at 64 storeys. Located on Sheikh Zayed Road, it has a sky lobby that offers stunning views of the Burj area. Other than that, there’s a private screening room, fitness and wellness centre, spa, a rooftop infinity swimming pool, and numerous other unprecedented facilities, making it one of the best skyscrapers in Dubai.

Floors 15 to 25 feature a selection of hotel rooms that are designed to offer an exceptional experience to guests. These rooms are tailored to offer them the highest level of comfort with the availability of modern conveniences. And not to forget, there’s an in-room home theatre and guests the exclusive access to the Paramount Films library. As for apartments, they are available on floors 26 through 63. These residential units combine the luxury of having a home along with trademark Paramount services.

As the Dubai real estate market currently favours buyers, it’s the right time to buy a property in DAMAC Paramount Hotel & Residences and earn a high ROI.

5. SLS Hotel & Residences

Concluding the list of the latest skyscrapers in Dubai, SLS Hotel & Residence offers a plush residential project, comprising a hotel and beautiful homes that offer stunning views of Burj Khalifa and glistering skyline of Dubai.  

It is a 75-storey building boasting a total of 964 units, divided into different categories. There are 321 hotel apartments, 254 hotel rooms and the rest (371), private residences.  

These residences are available in different sizes and layouts, ranging from studios, duplexes, single floor units, 1-bedroom units to 2-bedroom lofts. Every apartment comes with glass corners, terraces along with luxury furnishings and fittings. They are designed to offer every convenience and luxury to residents while giving them enhanced privacy and a serene environment. The unique design of the building allows natural sunshine and light to enter the living spaces, creating a vibrant ambience.

The Takeaway

The presence of these skyscrapers has also provided investors and end-users with an array of investment opportunities.
